description: This file defines a class 'Ssr' that extends a base Controller class in the Opencart framework. The class contains an 'index' method intended to generate static HTML pages from dynamically generated responses for specific routes in the e-commerce site. It is part of an event handling system that triggers after certain actions, such as loading product pages, categories, or content pages.

classes.name: Ssr
classes.description: A controller class responsible for creating static HTML snapshots of response pages based on certain routes in an OpenCart environment.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a static HTML file from the current response for specific routed pages if a route parameter is present in the request.
